item.title: Mizoram Quarry Collapse: 1 Dead, 2 Missing as Minister Visits Site
item.description: The site of a stone quarry collapse in Mizoram’s Sihphir Neihbawih last week, which resulted in the death of one worker, injuries to another and left two labourers missing under the debris, was visited by the state’s Disaster Management and Rehabilitation (DM&R) Minister Lalnilawma on Monday. item.title: 2 Incidents of Fire Reported in Guwahati on Uruka Night
item.description: Two incidents of inferno were reported in Guwahati on Uruka night, Tuesday. item.title: Assam: 2 Dead, 4 Injured as Speeding Car Runs over Youths amid Bihu Celebrations
item.description: The festive spirit of Bhogali Bihu was overshadowed by a tragic road accident in Teok under Assam’s Tinsukia district in the early hours of Wednesday. According to sources, a Scorpio vehicle ran over six youths at Bamunpukhuri’s Bihingiya village. Two youths, identified as Abhijit Phukan and Amrit Gogoi, died on the spot following the impact.
